---
title: "Data"
---

```{r}
source("R/nma_functions.R")
dat <- load_pairwise_data()
```

## Data preview

```{r}
DT::datatable(dat, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
```

## Data summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(summarise_pairwise_data(dat))
```

## Treatment nodes

```{r}
treatments <- sort(unique(c(dat$treat1, dat$treat2)))
knitr::kable(data.frame(Treatment = treatments))
```
